question: The value of the expression [Cot1°. Cot2°. Cot3°. Cot4°. Cot5° .... Cot178° Cot179°] is:
solution:
Given

Cot1°. Cot2°. Cot3°. Cot4°. Cot5° .... Cot178° Cot179°

Formula Used

cotθ = tan(90° - θ)

cotθ = 1/tanθ

Calculation

Cot1°. Cot2°. Cot3°. Cot4°. Cot5° .... Cot178 Cot179°

Cot90° = 0. (Since any value multiplied by 0 becomes 0, the value of the equation becomes 0)

⇒ 0

**The answer is 0.**
